findings.description: Nit: The proposal non-functional requirements matrix promises byte-identical supervisor_record round-trip fidelity, whereas design.md, spec.md, and tasks.md correctly specify structural equality after JSON decoding; PostgreSQL JSONB normalizes key order and formatting so byte-level equality cannot be guaranteed.
findings.resolution: Update the NFR matrix in proposal.md line 163 to specify structural equality after JSON decoding, aligning proposal.md with design.md and spec.md.

findings.description: The plan cleanly decouples repository-derived volatile state from non-derivable durable state, preserving git as source of truth without state drift.
findings.resolution: Maintain the derivable/non-derivable seam and dedicated mirror schema during implementation.

findings.description: The migration explicitly replaces legacy RPC overloads while retaining defaulted call behavior and descending read order.
findings.resolution: Retain the explicit DROP FUNCTION statements and compatibility coverage.

findings.description: The rehydration fallback chain degrades safely to the tracked mirror plus fresh repository derivation when the coordinator is unavailable.
findings.resolution: Preserve fallback order and degraded reporting.

findings.description: The object-or-null SQL constraint preserves structural safety while delegating rich inner-schema validation to the writer.
findings.resolution: Keep inner-schema validation in writer software and the lightweight SQL constraint.

findings.description: Idempotent mirror writes and fingerprint exclusion prevent self-triggering supervisor-cycle churn.
Supervisor-only retrieval is propagated across every named surface so ordinary handoffs cannot mask supervisor state.
findings.resolution: Keep supervisor_only exposed across all named surfaces.

findings.description: A single top-level supervisor_record key avoids API parameter inflation and supports inner-contract versioning.
